QuestInfo.name: The Storybook on Shim Chung
QuestInfo.0: I was sure I received the storybook after helping #p2071009# out, but where is it? Did I just lose it? I better go see #p2071009# again
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2040052## from Helios Tower Library has requested me to get #b#t4031280##k. Hmmm ... I'm pretty sure I received it after I lent #p2071009# 300 #t4031279#s, but I can't seem to find it. After discussing the matters with #p2071009#, he promised to give me the storybook if I gather up #b10 #t4000165#s#k for Shim Chung, who's quite a florist, to make her favorite flower.\n\n#t4000165#  #b#c4000165##k / 10
QuestInfo.2: I gathered up 10 #t4000165#s, which are Shim Chung's favorite, at the request of #p2071009# in order to reacquire #t4031280#.

0.0: Ah, hello! Are you here to collect the rice you've rented out to us? Well... the problem is, I am not in position to pay you back, just yet... can you come back later? \r\n#L0##bNo, no, that's not why I'm here. Actually, I lost the storybook that you gave me before, and I was wondering if you can give me another one ...#k
0.1: What? You lost it? How... ? It's our family treasure... I'm not reprimanding you for this, though; I already gave you that item. Thankfully, I have a copy of it with me. I'll give you that, but first... I'd like you to do me a small favor.

yes.0: Actually, tomorrow is my daughter Shim Chung's birthday. I should get her a birthday present, but... it can't be something too expensive... so I've decided to make a flower that Shim Chung likes the most. In order to make one, I'll need some materials to work with, so please gather up #b10 #t4000165#s#k that #r#o2230200##k drops. #r#o2230200##k can be found somewhere in #bAqua Road#k.

no.0: I'm sorry, but this is the last copy I have, and I don't want to give this to you for free.

1.0: Wow, the color's just beautiful. My daughter should really like it. Thank you very much. Here, take this, and please don't lose it this time.

item.0: Did you not find #b10 #t4000165#s#k? It's the leaf of a flower that grows on the head of #b#o2230200##k.
